[spoiler=מגני מולדתנו]
[b]DEFENSE COUNCIL [/b]

The Defense Council, acting under the authority and approval of the Prime Minister and the Knesset authorizes all necessary military action in Maarav for the purposes of removing the foreign imperialist presence and establishing a free state in Maarav. 

[i]הגנת המדינה ועמיה
מגני מולדתנו[/i]

[b]PRIME MINISTER HILA ROSEN 
DEFENSE MINISTER AVI COHEN[/b]

[u][b]Operation Sentinel - Naval Contest[/b][/u]

The overarching purpose of the Mizrahel Air Force and the Mizrahel Navy in this war would be to completely cut off Thyven and THEP ties to Maarav. Distance would be used to the advantage of Mizrahel to contest supply lines to Maarav. 

First small USVs would be deployed across Maarav, especially in cluttered littoral waters where it would be more difficult to pick them out. Peretz-Harris Dgals would swarm Thyven ships in the hundreds across Maarav waters either releasing loitering munition drones or ramming them with their onboard warheads. The purpose would be to expend Thyven ammunition and overwhelm with the sheer number of angles of attack. From under the waters, Ray UUVs would begin the task of mining Maarav waters. Hammerhead mines would be laid across the waters of Maarav, armed with torpedoes and strapped to the seabed making them hard to detect. These mines would remain inactive until enemy ships are identified in the area, making them hard to detect especially when considering the depths they are laid at. The glide structure of the UUVs would also limit the noise made and thus limit the ability of sonar to detect them. Additionally, the data bubble system used to communicate with commanders would make tracking much harder. Finally, the UUVs would also provide constant harassment of Thyven ships and submarines in the area. Massed groups of the UUVs would swarm Thyven vessels and attack them using their MK58 CRAW torpedoes hidden within their bays. Using a combination of saturated aperture radar, reconnaissance drones and SIGINT from the EA-18Gs the Mizrahel Security Forces move to pinpoint the locations of Thyven ships. B25-EX stealth bombers taking off from Tzfat would move to saturate the defenses of Thyven ships in the area. The 500-lb variant of the quicksink JDAM would be used en masse. Each of the bombers would be able to engage up to 80 targets at once, allowing the stealth bombers to strike the Thyven fleet hundreds of times at the same time using the guided bombs. However, this wouldnt be the only method of overwhelming Thyven ship defenses. On top of the USVs, UUVs, JDAMs and mines rapid dragon cells would be deployed. Thousands of kilometers away, C-130 cargo ships drop their rapid dragon missile pallets out of their cargo bays. Armed with 48 FAMM cruise missiles per cargo plane hundreds of FAMM cruise missiles are used to try to overwhelm the limited interceptor missiles. The relatively low cost cruise missiles utilize their AI programming to make in-flight decisions on course and target selection making them highly maneuverable and harder to intercept and jam as a direct connection to a directing system isnt required. 

While lighting up Thyven radar with massive amounts of inbound munitions and attempting to exhaust missile interceptors, the EA-18Gs of the Mizrahel Navy move to help further degrade Thyven defenses. From the Solomon-class CATOBAR carriers the EA-18Gs carry out BVR jamming of Thyven systems. Low-frequency pods work to jam the early warning radar while high-frequency ones hit the fire control ones, aiming to knock out the Thyven ability to detect incoming projectiles but also the ability to respond and guide interceptors. However, the EA-18Gs offer yet another layer of offense on the Thyven fleet. The EW pods onboard also help to spoof the Thyven radar, generating a host of aircraft targets in places where they dont exist to confuse the enemy and waste precious resources and time. Additionally, when all other methods fail the EA-18G can provide a kill as well. Bursts of microwave energy work to fry Thyven electronics and radar systems and take out the Thyven ability to respond and defend. This EW attack is constant as the multi-directional function of the EW pods allows the EA-18G to provide EW capabilities when entering and exiting the fight. From before visual range, the KF-35Ms fire off JASSM-XR standoff missiles from massive lengths. The radar coating and low-observability airframe of the missile help to minimize the already stressed Thyven radar from detecting the missiles as they cruise towards their targets. The 1,000-lb armor penetrating warhead aboard is aimed towards the enemy fleet. Additionally, the KF-35Ms fire off their HALO hypersonic missiles towards the enemy fleet. Flying along the curvature of the planet and with high maneuverability, the hypersonic missiles are both hard to intercept and detect on top of their already high speed of mach 5+. Taking off from the mainland the F-16CJs work to suppress the Thyven radar and their ability to detect the incoming wave of munitions. From their undersides they fire MALD drones into Maarav and over the Thyven fleet. The MALD decoys have two purposes: first their onboard EW suite adds another layer of jamming and their signature is a near copy of Mizraheli aircraft. Should Thyven radar activate at any time to intercept the incoming munitions, the anti-radiation missiles of the F-16CJs stand ready to permanently destroy them. Once they activate, the anti-radiation missiles are fired and continually track the radar emission source even after its deactivated. The extremely small warhead and airframe make it harder to detect while allowing the missile to traverse at supersonic speeds towards its targets. The AGM-88G extended range anti-radiation missiles allow for a two-way datalink to nullify jamming attempts and help to extend the distance between the F-16s and their targets. NMESIS systems carrying sea-skimming naval strike missiles are fired from their ground autonomous platforms towards the enemy fleet as well as the PrSM anti-ship ramjet ballistic missile variant from HIMARS. Finally, towards the most defended Thyven ships, the air launched ballistic missiles or ALBMs are fired from the F-15EXs. These anti-ship ballistic missiles move at hypersonic speeds near mach 10 to make it extremely hard to intercept them. 

[u][b]Operation Shamat Lion - Air and Ground Contest[/b][/u]

Acting with the element of surprise in a preemptive strike, the Mizrahel Air Force (MAF) works to hit the aerospace infrastructure of Maarav as hard as possible. F-16CJs work to suppress the Maarav IADS. The AGM-88G standoff range anti-radiation missile tracks the emissions of radar to take out SAMs. Should the systems activate, the ARMs will be able to continually track them even if they deactivate. At the same time, the EA-18Gs uses its bursts of energy to fry the systems of the SAMs and early warning systems while creating false targets to waste resources and reveal the location of SAMs. MALD drones add to another layer of deception, the physical decoys imitate the signature of the F-16s creating more false targets to reveal the locations of SAMs while using their EW suites to jam their early warning systems and fire control. MAI Harpy loitering munition drones are also dispatched across the border en masse from their tube canisters. The small, autonomous and low-flying drones will be extremely hard to counter as they search for radar emissions and dive onto them with their warheads when they do find them. B25-EX stealth bombers hit Maarav air bases with GBU-38 SDBs being used against any aircraft on the ground or in their hangars. KF-35Ms use their Paveway laser guided bombs combined with INS and GPS M-coded guided systems to hit aerial fuel stores, arms depots and runways to move to cripple the Thyven air force in the region. In the air, the jets work to methodically shoot down any Thyven jets. Using the AIM-174B from 400 kilometres away at BVR, the KF-35Ms target any remaining jets in the air. From the ground the LTAMDS guided SAMs add yet another layer of additional firepower to shoot down the enemy's aircraft. The 360-degree coverage of the LTAMDS and the ability to track hundreds of targets at a time allows the LTAMDS to aid the KF-35Ms in shooting down the Thyven jets. Support aircraft would become targets as well. Long range AIM-174B gunslingers fired from forward CCAs target the aerial refuelers of the enemy to hit at their ability to remain consistently in the air. Additionally, the KF-35Ms continually target AWACS with the specifically designed long-range PH5 supersonic missile. 

Nechsch Yim-class nuclear attack submarines move to shallower depths thousands of kilometers away from Maarav. Using their arsenals of 158 cruise missiles each and combined with the ongoing persistent assaults on Thyven air defenses they launch their attacks. A combined over 300 Tomahawk cruise missiles are fired from underwater platforms towards Maarav with targets including Thyven command and control centers to kill military leaders and disrupt defensive operations. Additionally, the cruise missiles add another angle of attack onto Thyven military infrastructure. Runways, aerospace fuel depots, arms depots, military bases and others are targets of the cruise missile strike. Rapid dragon cells would also aid in the ground offensive. Barracuda cruise missiles, low cost alternatives, would be released in swarms onto Thyven troops and military infrastructure helping to strike roads, bridges, tunnels and other transportation mechanisms to stall a response. CHAMP EMP missiles are released from the rapid dragon cells as well, releasing bursts of microwaves to fry and destroy the electronics of enemy systems in Maarav. 

From ground mobile ground stations across Mizrahel, Switchblade 600 loitering munitions are fired into Maarav. These drones work to target both tanks and armored vehicles used by the Thyven military. Diving onto the top of tanks where armor is typically less heavy the Switchblade 600s have the advantage of a fire and forget system making them very hard to jam. Their small size, swarms and extremely fast diving speeds will give APS a significant challenge. Tandem heavy anti-tank warheads inside the drones, based on the javelin, are specifically designed to help break through reactive armor. From their ramps, Peretz-Harris Atlas drones fire into Maarav as well. Designed to operate in GPS-denied environments, the autonomous system uses its electro-optical systems and machine learning to deliver both fragmentation and penetrator warheads onto the enemy at a low cost. With close air support the armor of the MGF begin to move forward into Maarav territory. HDT Hunter Wolf autonomous ground vehicles push forward ahead of MGF Namers, Merkavas and Eitans while also carrying equipment for troops on the ground. 
[/spoiler]

[i]F-15s entered the battlefield under dominant air superiority, using ISR data to lock onto Valdderan frontlines. Valdderan SAM sites struggled to respond, as the F-15's superior standoff range kept pilots safe from Valdderan SAM missile range. The AESA radar asset allowed the F-15 to track multiple targets at once, while also insignificantly augmenting the Eagle's radar cross section.  Utilizing data from AWACs, drones, and Growlers already present on the battlefield, the Eagles deployed their JASSM-er armaments. Standoff strike bombs that relieved the jets of having to fly over their targets. The missiles targetted and struck major Valdderan military nodes, logistics, and resource refineries with surgical precision with the assistance of GPS and terminal IR seekers. Each of the JASSM's targets were chosen carefully, as Daesunite command shifted their approach to war with Valddera from a swift take over to a short term attrition. 

The Virginia class  threaded through Valdderan skirmishes almost impossible to detect with their pump-jet propulsion and sound-isolated machinery that allowed the ship to remain extremely quiet. This proved a critical factor in the ships role in the northern theatre, as Valdderan ships struggled to even pick up a single ping from the Virginia. Utilizing passive sonar tracking, the submarine was able to detect Valdderan ships before they could detect it, and even before that, it was already too late. As simultaneously, the submarine would deploy its Mk48 torpedoes, guided by wire systems from the Virginia, the torpedoes closed in on their targets. It was akin to a thread being guided through a needle, each movement the Valdderan ship made, the Virginia class would readjust, fixing the torpedoes guidance towards the target again. In addition, P8 Poseidons watching the battle afar transferred data to the Virginia via sonobouys, which allowed for the Submarine to gain range estimates, contact trajectories, classifications, and more. 

On shore, the rest of NSTF-1 continued their valiant fight against the Valdderans. Arleigh-Burke class destroyers entered the battlefield AEGIS class radar reach, granting them long range tracking and targetting capability over any Valdderan ship in the flash zone. Valdderan naval skirmishes remained rather ineffective, as the Arleigh-Burke's multi-phased Aegis combat system quickly tracked, targetted, and destroyed any incoming missiles and ordinance incoming. The Burkes would utilize CEC to grant them the ability to share data with the Virginia's burst transmissions, granting them the ability to act as one interdependent force. Also utilizing data from the Poseidon's sonobouys, the Burke's were able sophisticated coordinates of Valdderan military positions, granting them the ability to respond with MST variants. But the Burkes did not focus only on antiship warfare, Tomohawks were also directed to coastal nodes on the two main islands, striking the already weakened Valdderan defense presicely. The independence classes also worked in the equation, acting as fast-action skirmishers, while also engaging low-value targets such as patrol boats and gunboats, opening way as a forward for the soon to be amphibious landing.

With a path cleared, and the battle decisive, it was now time for the first phase in the invasion. The Antonio-class LPD, the head of NSTF-1 was now ready. Carrying battalions of marines and LCACs, the Antonio was the central node to the amphibious assault, and therefore was top priority in terms of defense. With Valdderan artillery bombarded and distracted with pre-emptive Tomohawk attacks, Antonio had an open path towards the shoreline. Utilizing CEC, the LPD coordinates fire control with the Burkes, Independences, and Virginias to ensure an open beachhead. When the Antonio reached shallow water range, the LPD released its hatch, allowing for ACV 1.1s and LCACs to flood out, conducting a AOA landing on the Valdderan coast and securing a stable beach head for further operations. 

Only a couple hours after Hydronia had captured the capital, the 103rd airborne regiment would also make their long awaited arrival. AH-64's provided powerful ground defense. Uitlizing Hydra-70s guided manually with the assistance of cockpit electronics, the Apaches were able to effectively thwart any Valdderan resistance on their airlift to the Valdderan capital. [/i]

[b]EDU Extension of Membership to Massanikos and the United States of Lockheed[/b]

[i]The EDU Council is pleased to announce the further expansion of EDU membership to the states of Massanikos and the United States of Lockheed. On top of the membership accession of Krilmor and the raising of Daesun to associate status, the further expansion of the Union furthers our core missions of collective defense, security, and economic cooperation. This agreement is the product of weeks of productive and extensive negotiations with both states by the member states of the EDU. Today, the Council has successfully unanimously voted to add both states to the Union. 

Economically, the entrance of both states into the visa-free Elseyran zone will help to expand the EDU research pool, improve employment opportunities, support the free flow of labor, and bolster tourism. The unified customs union will additionally work to reduce the amount of trade barriers through common safety standards and digitized customs. The time-proven model of free trade within the EDU will further the ability of the USL and Massanikos to export their products to Elseyran and associated markets while lowering prices of imports to their respective nations. The prices of energy, technologies, automobiles, and more will be lowered while quality will be improved from the exchange of industry knowledge and greater international cooperation. Additionally, both states will have access to the Elseyran Union Fund, which will help provide a safety net for their economies. The combined monetary fund for the EDU works to employ a wide range of fiscal and monetary tools, from quantitative easing to the movement of interest rates, to stop recessions. Such a support system, the EDU believes, will help support investor confidence in the status quo while successfully managing risk. 

Finally, the entrance of both states presents greater opportunities for security cooperation. Both states will be granted entrance into joint EDU research programs, be allowed to import EDU weaponry on a larger scale, benefit from strategic deterrence and receive military aid. [/i]
